usedFor: inflow-inventory records orders and Signaturely handles signing, so “New Sales Order Created” can run “Create Folder” for signing.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Order Created” in inflow-inventory, then “Create Folder” in Signaturely
bestTemplate.why: Each sales order gets its own titled folder in Signaturely, ready for the documents that need signing.

watchOut: “Update Customer” fires on every edit, so “Create Folder” can run again and make a second folder for one customer.
